Definition: properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good for nothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be bad, be evil; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to be displeasing; 1a2) to be sad; 1a3) to be injurious, be evil; 1a4) to be wicked, be evil (ethically); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to do an injury or hurt; 1b2) to do evil or wickedly; 1b3) mischief (participle); 2) to break, shatter; 2a) (Qal); 2a1) to break; 2a2) broken (participle); 2a3) to be broken; 2b) (Hithpolel) to be broken, be broken in pieces, be broken asunder
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
